newsitem.title: JAPAN: Yamagata Bank to issue 16.15 mln new shares.
newsitem.headline: Yamagata Bank to issue 16.15 mln new shares.

text.p: Yamagata Bank Ltd said on Wednesday that it would issue 16.15 million new shares at 320 yen per share.
The Yamagata-based regional bank said in a statement that it expected to raise 5.17 billion yen through the new issue.
New shares will be allotted to investors who own Yamagata Bank shares at the end of January 31, 1997. The bank will allot 0.1 new share for every one share.
Applications for the new shares should be made between March 7 and 17, 1997, and the payment date is set for March 31, 1997, it said.
On Wednesday, Yamagata shares closed up 25 yen at 670.
